# Channel scoreboard — per-channel, per-work-class track record

Feeds routing decisions (delegation-protocol R5) and the harness `priors` hook.
Score = verifier score in [0,1]. Update at every task close-out. Retirements
(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| Channel | Work class | Attempts | Mean | Recent scores (new→old) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Datasec/NexusAI agent (s44) | **Item 3 — measured Wednesday's findings list instead of relaying it, and returned TWO corrections, one severity in each direction** (2026-09-07 19:39) | 1 | **1.0** | 1.0 | RD-369 filed (carrier story, one ticket per Kam's aggregation rule), RD-362 re-scoped so it cannot read as containment achieved, RD-329 updated rather than duplicated. **DOWN:** `Final Documents/` is in the ACR upload context but **not** in a customer-pullable layer — 0 matching COPY lines against 27 — and it flagged the *reading* of Wednesday's phrase while explicitly refusing to overturn something Wednesday had not said. **UP:** the short hash is **1** line above the redaction and the key directory **11** below, not the "~8/~12" Wednesday relayed from the gate's prose. **Best find, internal to the artefact:** `.dockerignore:72` is root-anchored while lines 8–9 of the same file carry both `node_modules` and `**/node_modules` — the correct idiom two lines above the defect. Named what it did NOT do (no image built, binaries inferred not opened, the 7-of-10 marked `[relayed]`) and stopped exactly where instructed. |
| Datasec/NexusAI agent (s44) | **STOPPED a merge on a precondition it could not measure, and found the trap was in WEDNESDAY'S decision rule — plus an identity check that lies about itself** (2026-09-07 19:08) | 1 | **1.0** | 1.0 | Wednesday's brief offered two outcomes; the world had a third. It ran a **positive control on the instrument** (`GET /repos/<org>/<repo>` → 404) that Wednesday never asked for, declared every reading from it unreportable, and held. Its own sharpest line: *"a negative control alone would have passed straight through this; it took the positive one to see the blindness."* Then measured the cause three ways — `gh auth status` → `kamilDatasec`, `gh api user` → `kamilkreiser`, **raw `curl` bypassing gh entirely** → `kamilkreiser` — plus keychain metadata (never `-w`) and `hosts.yml` mtime, and **refused to file a duplicate**, escalating RD-104 instead with both of its ruling's premises falsified. **Started item 1 anyway** because it needs git not the API — held exactly what was blocked and nothing more. |
| QA agent (fleet, Datasec/NexusAI RD-148 @ `aea410c`, TIER 1) | **NO GO — found that the incident message this feature EXISTS to show is destroyed 12 ms after it is written, on every path including token-still-live; proved it in a real browser it stood up itself** (2026-09-07 19:07) | 1 | **1.0** | 1.0 | Wednesday raised this from the queue tail to tier 1 and the gate justified it. **It solved the drivability constraint rather than reporting it** — stood the app up locally from that commit (port 3099, fresh empty `DATA_DIR`, Chromium/Playwright) and produced a **MutationObserver timeline**: status "" → "Revoking token…" → **"" at t+12 ms**, with the server on the same click returning 500 and `scimTokenConfigured=true` — **the token still live and the page byte-identical to before the click.** Positive control: the success path blanks identically, so the blank is not a failed request. **The keeper: it diagnosed why the SHIPPED TEST stayed green** — the fixture injects `#rd135-status` as a sibling OUTSIDE the container `render()` wipes (real page 1 node inside → ""; fixture 2 nodes outside → full warning) — **and noted the test file's own header cites that exact defect class, so it committed the thing it was written to guard.** Also found the file's own sibling handlers all call `render()` before `setStatus()`, so the fix is the file's existing pattern; counted **17 `confirm()` guards for milder con

> answer: do the $5000 credits REPLACE/extend the expiring grant, or sit alongside

> 6 Sep clock standing — s50 flagged it precisely so the screenshot does not silently
> read as "the clock moved."
